transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I got scared enough that I thought I should talk to someone. It’s a little embarrassing to say, but I’ve been hearing my name called, like from the hallway at home. And one time it happened at the warehouse too, when nobody was there.

It sounds real—like my husband is standing right next to me saying it. I know that probably sounds strange… I just didn’t want to ignore it if it’s something I should be getting help for.
Do you believe someone is actually calling your name when this happens?

At first I kind of do, yeah… because it sounds so real. Like, not just in my head, but like my husband is right there in the hallway calling me. But then when I look, nobody’s there. And at the warehouse it happened once too, when I was sure no one was around.

I know that probably sounds odd… I’m not trying to make it into something bigger than it is, but it scared me.
Besides hearing your name, have you heard any other voices or sounds that other people couldn’t hear?

No… not really other voices, I don’t think. It’s mostly just my name being called. Like from the hallway at home, and that one time at the warehouse when nobody was there.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it sounds real—like my husband is right next to me saying it. That’s the part that scared me.
Have you started to feel that someone is trying to harm you or watch you?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I get startled by the voice thing, but I haven’t really felt like someone is out to hurt me or watching me.

At least… not that I’ve noticed. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling confused lately?

Confused? Um… I don’t think so, not really. I mean, I get overwhelmed sometimes and I might lose my train of thought, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been confused.

Unless you mean something specific? Like not knowing where I am or what’s going on? Because no, I haven’t noticed that.
Do these times when you hear your name happen as you’re falling asleep or waking up?

Not really… I mean, I don’t think it’s just when I’m half-asleep or waking up. The times that scared me were when I was up—like hearing my name from the hallway at home, and that one time at the warehouse when nobody was there.

It just sounded so real, like my husband was standing right next to me saying it. I know that sounds strange… but that’s what made me come in.
Have you started believing things that other people say aren’t true?

I wouldn’t say I believed anything too strange… at least I don’t think so. I did get really convinced that I could turn my crafts into, like, a real retirement business right away. Like I had figured out the perfect plan for our family, and once people saw it they’d understand.

Maybe that sounds unrealistic now, but at the time it felt… really clear to me. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
During this time, have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah… I guess I was sleeping a lot less than normal. I didn’t really feel tired, though, which is why I didn’t think of it as a problem at first.

For a while I was only getting maybe two or three hours, and then I’d wake up ready to go, like sleeping was just… wasting time I needed for my projects. Does that count as needing less sleep?
During this time, did you feel unusually high, euphoric, or unusually irritable?

I mean… not “happy” exactly, but I did feel really fired up. Like I had all this energy and I was sure I could make the craft business work, and I got pretty intense about how things should be done at home.

And… I don’t like admitting this, but I was more snappy with my husband than usual. He’d make one little comment and I’d take it like he was trying to hold me back. I know that probably wasn’t fair.
Have you heard your name being called only during the time when you were sleeping very little and felt especially energized?

Yes… I think that’s right. It only happened during that stretch when I was hardly sleeping and felt really wound up, like I had to fix everything and couldn’t stop talking about it.

Before that, I don’t remember hearing anything like that. And later, when I kind of dropped into that low, shut-down place, it wasn’t happening then either. It was just during that energized time… if that makes sense.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in almost everything most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, but after all that running around and arguing, I kind of just… dropped.

It was this heavy, empty feeling. I’d sit at the kitchen table and cry over nothing, like I couldn’t get myself back. I guess that did go on for a while… probably at least a couple weeks. Does that answer what you mean?
Before this recent energized period, had you ever had another episode in your life when you felt similarly unusually energized and needed much less sleep?

I… I’m not really sure. Nothing that stands out the same way as this recent time.

I mean, I’ve had times where I was busy or pushing myself, like anyone, but I don’t know that I’d say I had another period where I was that energized and barely sleeping. At least, not that I can clearly remember. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
At any time after that energized period ended, did you still hear your name being called?

No… not that I can remember. It was really just during that time when I wasn’t sleeping and I was talking so much and felt like I had to fix everything.

Once I kind of came down and got into that low, withdrawn place, I don’t think I heard it anymore. I haven’t had voices or anything like that since then. Is that what you’re asking?
